description: Accept the AI suggestion through a whole charge, in a LOCAL hot-seat game (no AI seat). K in the Charge phase suggests a charge; clicking the card's '✔ Accept' declares it for the player. Pressing K and Accept again carries out each follow-up the AI suggests (charge roll, charge move, any defender window) until the AI would end the phase — every accept succeeds and the game never leaves the Charge phase on its own.

steps.script:
var n: Array = tree.root.find_children("CommandRerollDialog", "", true, false).filter(func(w): return w.visible and not w.is_queued_for_deletion())
return n.size()
